# Mohamed Barkat — Senior Performance Marketer

> Performance marketer and creative strategist with 5+ years in paid acquisition for super apps, D2C brands, local businesses and B2B teams. Runs paid growth as one system: plan, track, create, launch, analyze, and get found (SEO and AI visibility). Based in Ho Chi Minh City, working remotely.

## Services
- Growth audit: review of ad accounts, tracking and attribution, creative, landing pages, SEO and AI visibility, with a prioritized fix list.
- Build & launch: conversion tracking setup, creative strategy and briefs, campaign build and first test cycle.
- Growth partner: ongoing ownership of paid social, paid search, creative strategy, reporting and SEO.
- Single services: paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Reddit), paid search (Google Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Shopping), tracking and attribution (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, server-side), creative strategy, SEO and AI visibility, landing pages and CRO.

## Selected results (client names withheld)
- Super app, North Africa: 116,464 first deliveries in 2025 at $1.81 each on $211K acquisition spend; managed about $50K/month across Meta, Google and TikTok.
- High-ticket wellness equipment (D2C): 9.96x platform-attributed ROAS on Meta Advantage+, $114,150 purchase value from $11,462 spend.
- House painting, Canada: 4,460 Google Ads conversions at CA$46.44.
- Consumer electronics e-commerce: 28,881 website purchases at €1.41 (Meta, platform-attributed).
